boot.venv_failed: Could not create the virtual environment.
lang.title: Language
interrupted: Interrupted. Run the installer again: it picks up where it left off.
pre.mac_intel: Intel Mac: PyTorch has shipped no macOS x86_64 build since 2.2 and everything would run on the processor — the engine may well refuse to start
pre.disk_short: not enough free space on {drive}: {free} available, {needed} required
pre.cuda_old: torch CUDA « {cuda} » < 13: no int8 backend, falling back to bf16
pre.cuda_hint: --variant quantized overrides this if your stack does int8
pre.cuda_too_old: {name}: compute capability {cap}, below the {minimum} the CUDA 13 build needs — the card cannot be used
pre.variant_eager: int8 forced without CUDA: no dedicated kernels, everything falls back to eager — lighter on memory than bf16, but slower
pre.ram_short: {ram} of RAM for models that weigh {needed} once loaded: expect swapping
pre.cpu_mode: No usable GPU: ComfyUI will run on the processor ({args})
pre.cpu_slow: Count on tens of minutes per image, not seconds.
pre.cpu_bf16: {ram} of RAM: the UNet is forced to bf16, fp32 would need about 24 GB for it alone.
deps.label: pip install -r {file}
deps.failed: pip install -r requirements.txt failed — see the messages above
dl.no_range: the server ignores Range, resuming is impossible: starting over
dl.mismatch: {label}: received {got} instead of {expected} — run the installer again
comfy.extract_retry: the external extractor failed, trying py7zr
comfy.no_extractor: no 7z extractor available: install 7-Zip, or `pip install py7zr`
comfy.no_release: no portable NVIDIA release found on GitHub — install ComfyUI yourself and run again with --comfy-dir
comfy.no_git: git is missing: install it, or point --comfy-dir at an existing installation
comfy.reused_note: (nothing is copied: the models go into its own models/)
comfy.ask_path: Path to an existing installation, or Enter to install:
comfy.invalid: {path} has neither main.py nor a ComfyUI interpreter
comfy.still_invalid: installation finished but {path} is still invalid (main.py or interpreter missing)
comfy.remove_failed: cannot delete {path} — a program may be holding it open (file explorer, antivirus, ComfyUI still running). Close it and try again.
ollama.gui: the graphical installer opens: finish it, then come back here
ollama.winget_failed: winget failed, falling back to the graphical installer
ollama.brew_failed: brew failed, falling back to the .dmg
ollama.sudo: this script asks for sudo: you may be prompted for your password
ollama.script_failed: the official script failed — install Ollama by hand if you want it
ollama.unreachable: service unreachable — translation stays off for now
ollama.pitch1: Ollama is missing. It translates your prompts into English before
ollama.pitch2: they reach the model. Without it everything still works, but a prompt
ollama.pitch3: written in your language goes as-is. Cost: ~1 GB of software + 3.3 GB of model.
ollama.linux_sudo: On Linux, installing it asks for sudo.
ollama.declined: Ollama not installed: prompts will go verbatim.
ollama.no_service: Ollama installed but the service is not answering yet
ollama.rerun: run the installer again later: it will pick up the model
done.add_later: (run install.py again later to add it)
done.listen: The studio will listen on http://127.0.0.1:{studio} and ComfyUI on {comfy}.
cli.variant: force the model variant instead of deducing it
cli.comfy_dir: root of a ComfyUI installation to reuse or create
cli.no_ollama: do not install Ollama, and do not ask
cli.no_run: do not start the studio once the installation is done
cli.yes: accept the defaults without asking anything
